question: Where is the nearest restaurant you’d find going toward Gary Lapelusa Landscaping LLC, Bayonne, NJ starting at Science Hall East, Wayne, NJ?
sql: WITH start_loc AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Science Hall East%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Wayne%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NJ%' LIMIT 1 ), end_loc AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Gary Lapelusa Landscaping LLC%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Bayonne%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NJ%' LIMIT 1 ), target_info AS ( SELECT s.geometry AS start_geom, e.geometry AS end_geom, degrees(ST_Azimuth(s.geometry, e.geometry)) AS target_bearing_deg FROM start_loc s, end_loc e WHERE s.geometry IS NOT NULL AND e.geometry IS NOT NULL ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_state, p.addr_city FROM pois p, target_info ti WHERE p.amenity = 'restaurant' AND ti.start_geom IS NOT NULL -- Ensure start point was found AND ti.end_geom IS NOT NULL -- Ensure end point was found AND ST_Distance(ti.start_geom::geography, p.geometry::geography) > 0 -- Exclude the start point itself AND ( -- Calculate the angular difference between the bearing from the start to the restaurant -- and the target bearing (from start to end_loc). -- Ensure it's within +/- 45 degrees (a 90-degree cone) of the target bearing. LEAST( ABS(degrees(ST_Azimuth(ti.start_geom, p.geometry)) - ti.target_bearing_deg), 360 - ABS(degrees(ST_Azimuth(ti.start_geom, p.geometry)) - ti.target_bearing_deg) ) <= 45 ) ORDER BY ST_Distance(ti.start_geom::geography, p.geometry::geography) ASC LIMIT 1;
